_what: People kept in a list from a source (src/list-people.mjs): which list fields a person's values fill, how each merges (trillion-workshop tools/person-list/do-work/merge-people.mjs), how an existing list's fields are matched so no near-duplicate is added, the limits and the words of every refusal. A new value a source can send is one fill row here.

words.bad_source: Name the source as { id, label }: id a short name of letters, digits and dashes like "mac-contacts", label the words people see like "Mac Contacts".
words.bad_people: Send people as a list of at most {limit}, each { key, name?, phones?, emails?, organization?, job_title? }; key is the id the person has where they came from.
words.bad_person: Person {index} has no key: the id it has where it came from, so the next sync finds the same person.
words.needs_label: The list {list_id} does not exist yet; send list_label, the name people see, so it can be made.
words.too_large: That request is too large; send at most {limit} people at a time.
